Residential Feature · Provided by REZITRADE

REZITRADE Home Price Protection

Buying while prices feel uncertain? Eligible residential loans through Rezi Loans include REZITRADE Home Price Protection for the first 12 months at zero cost to you. If home values in your local market decline during that period, you may receive a cash payout — paid automatically, with nothing for you to file.

Ask About It on Rezi Loans →

Protection is provided by REZITRADE under its contract terms. Eligibility, the applicable market index, payout calculation, coverage period, and any limits are governed solely by the REZITRADE contract provided in connection with your loan. A payout is not guaranteed and depends on movement in the applicable index. REZITRADE Home Price Protection is not insurance, not a guarantee of your home's value, and not a product of Rigo Capital Solutions or E Mortgage Capital, Inc.

How It Works

What working with a broker looks like

A broker works for you, not for one bank. Here's the path from first call to closing.

1

Conversation & scenario

We talk through the property, purchase price or value, loan amount, timeline, and your goals — so the scenario is framed clearly before it goes anywhere.

2

Lender matching

We take the scenario to lending partners whose guidelines fit it, and compare the options on rate, cost, and fit — not just the headline number.

3

Through to closing

We coordinate with the lender, title, and the other parties, keep you updated on what's needed and when, and stay on the deal until it closes.

About

Led by Steven Rigo

Rigo Capital Solutions is the mortgage brokerage of Steven Rigo (NMLS #1977558), serving borrowers across four areas: residential home loans, investment property financing, commercial lending, and construction & rehab financing.

The broker model is the point. Instead of representing a single lender's products, Rigo Capital Solutions works with multiple lending partners — which matters most on deals that don't fit a standard template: an investor's rental portfolio, a fix-and-flip or heavy rehab project, a mixed-use property, or a business buying the building it operates from.

For residential borrowers, Steven works through his Rezi Loans page — that's the fastest route for a home purchase or refinance inquiry.

Questions

Common questions

Is Rigo Capital Solutions a lender or a broker?

A broker. Rigo Capital Solutions does not lend its own funds — it arranges financing through lending partners and matches each borrower's scenario to the partner whose guidelines and pricing fit best.

Where do I go for a residential home loan?

Residential lending runs through Steven Rigo's page at Rezi Loans: reziloans.com/steven-rigo. That's where home buyers and homeowners refinancing should start. Steven Rigo is NMLS #1977558, and Rezi Loans is powered by E Mortgage Capital, Inc., NMLS #1416824 — see the residential disclosures for full licensing and Equal Housing Opportunity information.

What is REZITRADE Home Price Protection — and is it insurance?

No, it is not insurance. REZITRADE Home Price Protection is a protection contract provided by REZITRADE that is included on eligible residential loans for the first 12 months at zero cost. If home values in your local market decline during that period, you may receive a cash payout automatically — there are no claims to file and no paperwork to submit, because payouts are triggered by movement in a local market index. Whether a payout occurs, and how much, is governed solely by the REZITRADE contract terms provided in connection with your loan.

What counts as construction & rehab financing?

Ground-up construction and new builds, fix-and-flip projects (purchase plus rehab budget), heavy rehab and major renovations, builder financing including spec homes, and rehab loans for investors who plan to hold the property after the work is done. Lenders will typically want the scope of work, a rehab or build budget, plans where they exist, and your exit strategy — sell, refinance, or hold.

What should I have ready for an investment, commercial, or construction inquiry?

The basics of the deal: property type and location, purchase price or estimated value, the loan amount you're looking for, rent or business income if it applies, and your target timeline. For construction and rehab, add the scope of work, your rehab or build budget, and whether you plan to sell, refinance, or hold the property when the work is done. The contact form below walks you through each one.

Does submitting an inquiry commit me to anything?

No. An inquiry starts a conversation. Any loan is subject to lender approval, underwriting review, and program availability at the time you apply.
